senses.en: the lofty nest of a bird of prey (such as a hawk or eagle)

examples.text: An eagle's aerie clung to the cliff face, far beyond the reach of any climber.

senses.en: any habitation at a high altitude

examples.text: From her mountaintop aerie, the novelist looked down on the village lights each evening.

senses.en: one who professes great sensitivity to the beauty of art and nature

examples.text: The aesthete declined the invitation, claiming that the ugly furniture would spoil his evening.

origin.ko: 그리스어 aisthētēs(지각하는 사람)에서 왔습니다. 아름다움을 예민하게 느끼는 사람입니다.

senses.en: concerning or characterized by an appreciation of beauty or good taste

examples.text: Planners argued that the new tower offered aesthetic value as well as practical office space.

senses.en: The set of artistic motifs defining a collection of things, especially works of art; more broadly, their aura or “vibe”.

examples.text: The studio's minimalist aesthetic runs through its posters, packaging, and even its office furniture.

origin.ko: 그리스어 aisthanomai(느끼다)에서 온 aisthētikos(감각의)가 어원입니다. 감각으로 아름다움을 느낀다는 뜻입니다.
